title: Recover the Hilbert polynomial of a projective quartic curve

source.citation: Janko Boehm, Wolfram Decker, and Frank-Olaf Schreyer, Commutative Algebra and Algebraic Geometry using OSCAR, arXiv:2404.12085

translation.notes: The two homogeneous equations are entered independently. Noether verifies the projective dimension, degree, and Hilbert polynomial 4m. The source also reports smoothness; Noether 0.2 does not certify smoothness for this presentation, so that assertion is retained only as a blocker in intake.
